feeds.title: A Catholic Girl Reads
feeds.description: Hi, I am Grace! I am a junior in high school whose biggest hobby is reading books. I first started to like books when my parents got me a reading tutor when I was in fifth grade. When quarantine started, I had a lot more time on my hands, so I decided that I wanted to share my love of good, clean, and wholesome books with everybody.

feeds.title: Good Books for Catholic Kids
feeds.description: Good Books for Catholic Kids is a website that provides reviews and recommendations for books that are appropriate for Catholic children. The website is run by Brittany, who is a Catholic mother of four. The website has a wide variety of book lists, including lists for different age groups, genres, and topics. The website also includes book reviews, author interviews, and other resources for Catholic families.

feeds.title: One Catholic Life
feeds.description: Nick Senger is a husband, a father of four, a Roman Catholic deacon, and a Catholic school principal. He taught junior high literature and writing for over 25 years, and has been a Catholic school educator since 1990. I love to read, and I love to write about books. Many of the posts here will be about the books I love, the books I'm reading, or the books I would like to read.

feeds.title: Happy Catholic
feeds.description: Happy Catholic is the personal blog of Julie Davis, known for her honest, often witty reflections on everyday Catholic life. She shares quotes, art, book and movie thoughts, and short spiritual insights highlighting how faith shows up in ordinary moments, sometimes in surprising or humorous ways.

feeds.title: A Lapsed Catholic Returns » Books
feeds.description: The book section of A Lapsed Catholic Returns will help you find catholic books to read.

feeds.title: Catholic Exchange » Books and Art
feeds.description: This section is exclusively dedicated to catholic books and art. Catholic Exchange seeks to enable all to be enriched and strengthened in their Christian faith as proclaimed by the Catholic Church. By offering accessible articles and helpful tools for spiritual growth, we seek to make saints in our own time especially among those who live busy lives but still seek to grow in friendship with Christ.

feeds.title: The Central Minnesota Catholic » Book Reviews
feeds.description: Book reviews by The Central Minnesota Catholic. The Central Minnesota Catholic is the official magazine of the Diocese of St. Cloud, Minnesota

feeds.title: The Catholic Index » Books
feeds.description: Welcome fellow pilgrims to The Catholic Index, where faith and culture fruitfully meet. Our aim is to review the best the surrounding culture has to offer, leaving no stone unturned. From films to vlogs, books to blogs, everything may be at the service of Christ - if we look in the right way!

feeds.description: The Catholic Man Reviews is a Catholic and Christian Products Reviews blog that is moderated by Vincent Pham.
